experiment: Local-only LightGCN vs FedAvg (20N Fixed FL Catalog)

evaluation_rules.local_only_strict_silo: Primary Local-only rule (no FedAvg aggregation, no global graph propagation). Each of the 20 clients trains its own local subgraph E_c independently for 4 rounds x 20 Adam steps = 80 steps (continuing locally without server averaging) and produces local propagated embeddings out_c = propagate(E_c, adj_c, L=2). For eval user u and catalog job j owned by client c = client_of_job[j], score(u, j) = out_c[u] @ out_c[j] if u appears in client c's local subgraph, and -1e9 if client c has never observed u (cannot transfer preferences across silos without FL aggregation).
evaluation_rules.local_only_stitched_eval_upper_bound: Sensitivity check (no FedAvg during training, post-hoc stitched eval only). Uses the exact same independently trained E_c matrices, stitches client embeddings by averaging nodes across clients that observed them, and runs full_forward once on ADJ_FULL at evaluation time. Included to isolate training-time aggregation vs eval-time cross-silo propagation.
